title: Learning Graph Viewer V1
description: First version of learning graph viewer with pinned foundation and goal nodes using vis.js.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Education
Graph Visualization
Learning Graphs
Knowledge Mapping
learningObjectives: Explain how setting node.fixed on the x axis anchors foundation concepts left and goal concepts right in a vis.js network
Identify foundation nodes by their red box shape and goal nodes by their gold star shape
Trace a dependency path from a pinned foundation concept to a pinned goal concept
Compare the pinned-group layout with the unconstrained physics layout of a default vis.js graph
